summary: Verified 91 raw findings against source. App is visually GREEN; no genuine P0, but ONE real safety-correctness P1 confirmed: bundled supplements_db.json ships pregnancy_safety="à_surveiller" (accented, 4/15 incl. Vitamine A) which NEVER matches code's ASCII 'a_surveiller', so getSafetyConfig() falls through `|| SAFETY_CONFIG.ok` → those 4 render GREEN ✓"Safe" on the list (SupplementDetail shows grey "Unknown", a contradictory mismatch), and the "À surveiller" filter chip returns zero of them. De-facto PRIMARY path: importData.ts:38 seeds a non-existent supplements_pregnancy.json so collection('supplements') is empty and ALL users hit the bundled fallback. Confirmed dead surface: WeekRecommendationsScreen is Firestore-only (no localContentFallback import) → guests/offline always get the empty state. Second P1 cluster is WCAG contrast: selected safety filter chips (white-on-pastel 1.7–3.0:1) and card safety pills (raw color on light tint 1.6–2.6:1) are illegible — the primary safety signal. Dominant value tier is UX/a11y/RTL/i18n-content: 7 horizontal chip/related scrollers miss the repo's proven dir=ltr web-RTL fix (chips unreachable in ar/tn); article markdown body has no RTL alignment; 2 of 3 search inputs lack accessibilityLabel; clear-✕ mislabeled a11y.close; empty-state shows 'No results for ""' on filter-only empties; EN favorites='Saved' collides with saved state; stripMarkdown leaks list/blockquote markers + double-spaces; getLocalizedContent has no AR-specific fallback hop. DISPUTED/DROPPED: the articles_db empty-related-ids gap (per instructions, not re-flagged); the AG-shape cross-link finding (latent data/shape, not code bug); perf memo findings (real but low-impact at 15–80 items, bundled to one P3); the prefix-match resolver tightening (latent only). Deduped 91→24 by anchor across 10 lenses. All fixes use existing theme tokens; new i18n keys flagged for all 4 langs.

improvements.title: SAFETY MISLABEL: data token 'à_surveiller' (accented) never matches code 'a_surveiller' → 4 supplements incl. Vitamine A render GREEN ✓Safe (verified: histogram {ok:11,'à_surveiller':4}; getSafetyConfig falls through `|| SAFETY_CONFIG.ok`)
improvements.fix: Normalize at the data boundary in localContentFallback.ts getAllLocalSupplements() AND getLocalSupplement(): map pregnancy_safety through SAFETY_ALIASES={'à_surveiller':'a_surveiller','déconseillé':'deconseille',...} (or .normalize('NFD').replace(/[̀-ͯ]/g,'')). PLUS fix the 4 rows in supplements_db.json to ASCII. PLUS change SupplementsListScreen.tsx:118 default from `|| SAFETY_CONFIG.ok` to an explicit neutral 'unknown' config so an unknown token never silently renders green. Add a jest guard asserting every pregnancy_safety ∈ {ok,a_surveiller,deconseille}.
improvements.acceptance: Vitamine A/zinc/vit C/selenium show ⚠ 'À surveiller' (orange) on list AND detail (no longer green/Unknown mismatch); the 'À surveiller' filter chip returns the 4 items; jest guard green; verified as guest (offline fallback path).

improvements.title: Card safety pill text/icon uses raw color on matching light tint → WCAG fail (#81C784 on #E8F5E9=1.79:1, #FFB74D on #FFF3E0=1.58:1, #E57373 on #FFEBEE=2.61:1) — primary safety signal illegible
improvements.fix: In SAFETY_CONFIG keep the light tint as bgColor but render TEXT+icon in dark tokens that already exist: green800 #2E7D32 on greenTint (4.56:1), red700 #D32F2F on rose (4.36:1, bold ok); for warning add a dark amber token (e.g. a #856404-class token in src/theme/index.ts — no inline hex) on orangeTint. Apply same mapping to WeekRecommendations getSafetyColor for the text/icon.
improvements.acceptance: All three safety pills' label+icon measure ≥4.5:1 (bold) against their tint in fr/en/ar/tn; visual unchanged tint, darker readable text.

improvements.title: Selected safety chip = white text on raw safety color → 1.73–2.99:1, active label nearly invisible (Favoris/All chips fine at accent 5.87:1 — only the 3 safety chips regress)
improvements.fix: Map each SAFETY_FILTERS entry to {fillSelected,textSelected}: white on green800 #2E7D32 (5.13:1) and red700 #D32F2F (4.98:1); for 'caution' the orange can't carry white — use dark text theme.colors.text #4E342E on light orange instead. Add a small leading color dot so inactive chips also read as a legend.
improvements.acceptance: Each selected safety chip label ≥4.5:1; inactive chips show a colored dot legend; verified 4 langs.

improvements.title: All 7 chip/related horizontal ScrollViews miss the repo's proven dir=ltr web-RTL fix → in ar/tn the row clamps and chips beyond the viewport (incl. safety filters, categories) are unreachable (verified: zero getScrollableNode/dir=ltr in any S5 screen; HomeScreen.tsx:267-274 has the pattern)
improvements.fix: Add a ref + web-only effect copying HomeScreen.tsx:267-274: if(Platform.OS==='web'&&isRTL){node=ref.current?.getScrollableNode?.();node?.setAttribute?.('dir','ltr')} re-dep on chip/list count. Best as a small reusable hook shared by all 5 screens. Derive isRTL via useRtl(). Live data path (SupplementDetail→related-article chips) must be validated in ar.
improvements.acceptance: In ar/tn web the Favoris/Tout chip is leading and the row scrolls from start to reveal all chips; first-chip x≈0 probe; LTR unaffected.

improvements.title: WeekRecommendations has NO bundled fallback → guests/offline ALWAYS get the empty state; 'supplements' collection is never seeded so its section never renders even for accounts (verified Firestore-only)
improvements.fix: After the getDoc filter, for any unresolved id fall back to getLocalArticle(id)/getLocalSupplement(id) (reuse exact-then-prefix resolver from ArticleDetailScreen). Guard the effect so a Firestore throw still attempts local resolution. Soften noRecommendation copy to frame general resources.
improvements.acceptance: As guest (offline), week with recommended_*_ids shows article AND supplement cards from bundled data; empty state only when truly no ids.

improvements.title: Empty-state interpolates {{query}} even when empty came from a filter → 'Aucun résultat pour ""' (most common: guest taps ★Favoris with zero bookmarks)
improvements.fix: Branch copy: if favoritesActive && !searchQuery.trim() → new key common.noFavoritesYet (★ + hint, add 4 langs); else if (selectedCategory||selectedSafety)&&!searchQuery → existing common.noResults (no query); else keep noResultsFor. Wrap empty View accessibilityLiveRegion='polite', mark emoji importantForAccessibility='no'. Symmetric both screens.
improvements.acceptance: Empty ★Favoris shows 'no favorites yet'; chip-only empty shows query-less message; no '""' in any lang; SR announces the change.

improvements.title: Article markdown body is not RTL-aligned → the largest content block in the app renders left-aligned ragged-left for ar/tn (cross-link chips got chipTextRTL but the body itself was missed)
improvements.fix: Build styles from a makeMarkdownStyles(isRTL): add writingDirection:isRTL?'rtl':'ltr' + textAlign:isRTL?'right':'left' to body/heading1-3/paragraph/list_item, pass to <Markdown style={md}>. writingDirection also fixes mixed Latin/Arabic medical-term bidi.
improvements.acceptance: Arabic/Tunisian article body is right-aligned with correct bidi for embedded Latin tokens; LTR unchanged.

improvements.title: Search input has no accessibilityLabel (placeholder only) and clear-✕ is labeled a11y.close ('Fermer/Close') — 2 of 3 search inputs inconsistent with ForbiddenFoods (verified FF:147 has label; a11y.clearSearch absent)
improvements.fix: Add accessibilityLabel={t('common.searchArticlePlaceholder')} / searchSupplement to both TextInputs (keys exist). Add new key a11y.clearSearch (4 langs) and use it on the ✕ buttons instead of a11y.close. Give the ✕ TouchableOpacity hitSlop 10 or minHeight/minWidth 44 (currently ~24px). On web add aria-label.
improvements.acceptance: SR announces the search field by name; ✕ announces 'Clear search'; ✕ hit area ≥44px; 4 langs.

improvements.title: Content search inputs lack textAlign:right + writingDirection:rtl in ar/tn (auth screens established inputRTL pattern; these 3 skipped it) → caret/placeholder left-aligned for Arabic typing
improvements.fix: Add searchInputRTL {textAlign:'right',writingDirection:'rtl'} and apply style={[styles.searchInput, isRTL && styles.searchInputRTL]} on all three (FF already has isRTL L68). Mirror RegisterScreen.tsx:380-382 tokens. No new i18n keys.
improvements.acceptance: ar/tn search caret starts right, placeholder right-aligned, glyphs shape correctly; LTR unchanged.

improvements.title: Cross-link chips apply flexDirection:'row-reverse' (chipRTL) ON TOP of document.dir=rtl on web → double-mirror puts the icon on the wrong side in ar/tn (the 'never row-reverse what dir already mirrors' trap)
improvements.fix: Gate chipRTL native-only: apply `isRTL && Platform.OS!=='web' && styles.chipRTL`. Keep chipTextRTL textAlign:'right' (additive, correct). Both detail screens. (Coordinate with rank 4 dir=ltr scroller fix.)
improvements.acceptance: In ar/tn web, related-chip icon sits on the leading edge (not double-mirrored); native RTL still correct. SupplementDetail→related-article chips (live data) verified.

improvements.title: stripMarkdown leaves blockquote '>' and list '-'/'*'/'1.' markers + double-spaces in card 2-line previews (verified: chain only strips headers/bold/italic/underline/code/links)
improvements.fix: Extend chain (keep /m): .replace(/^\s*>\s?/gm,'') .replace(/^\s*[-*+]\s+/gm,'') .replace(/^\s*\d+\.\s+/gm,'') then .replace(/[ \t]{2,}/g,' ') before trim. Add jest cases for '> ','- ','1. ' and the double-space.
improvements.acceptance: Summaries with bullet/quote/heading show clean prose, no leading markers, no double-space; unit tests green; all 4 langs.

improvements.title: For language 'ar' there is NO ar-specific fallback hop — a missing _ar field jumps straight to _en→_fr, surfacing French Latin prose inside an RTL screen for safety-critical dose/precautions (verified chain: target→(tn only)ar→en→fr)
improvements.fix: Make fallback script-aware: for langCode==='ar'||'tn', prefer data[arKey] before en/fr. Add a dev-only jest assertion that every safety field (supplements precautions/typical_dose, forbidden risk/alternative) has _ar present so missing translations fail CI not ship as French-in-RTL.
improvements.acceptance: ar locale never shows _en/_fr when _ar exists; CI guard fails on any missing _ar safety field. (Current bundled data has _ar so this is the latent-guard fix.)

improvements.title: severity 'low' renders GREEN border+badge on an AVOID food — collides with green=safe used by supplement pills + the safe-alternative row on the same card (1/19 items but semantically wrong on a safety screen)
improvements.fix: Map severity 'low' to a caution/neutral token (theme.colors.warning or a muted neutral), reserving green strictly for the safe-alternative row. Keep i18n severity label as source of truth; verify badge contrast on new color.
improvements.acceptance: No AVOID item renders green; 'low' badge reads as caution; contrast ≥4.5:1.

improvements.title: Food card TouchableOpacity exposes no accessibilityRole/accessibilityState{expanded} on the safety-critical screen; ▲/▼ glyph not SR-hidden; expanded detail/alternative texts lack the isRTL right-align the food name has (L219)
improvements.fix: Add accessibilityRole='button', accessibilityState={{expanded:isExpanded}}, accessibilityLabel=`${name} — ${severityLabel}`, accessibilityHint={t('a11y.expandDetails')} (new key 4 langs). Mark ▲/▼ importantForAccessibility='no'. Apply isRTL && {textAlign:'right'} to detailText/alternativeText/labels to match foodName.
improvements.acceptance: SR announces button + expanded/collapsed state + name+severity; ar/tn expanded text right-aligned consistently.

improvements.title: Foods search has no clear-✕ on Web/Android (clearButtonMode is iOS-only) while the other two screens render a custom ✕; and search indexes name+risk+alternative but NOT the displayed 'details' field → false 'no results'
improvements.fix: Add the same conditional ✕ TouchableOpacity (onPress setSearchQuery('')) the other screens use, accessibilityLabel={t('a11y.clearSearch')} (rank 8 key); keep clearButtonMode for iOS. Add a 4th OR clause `|| normalizeForSearch(getLocalizedContent(f,'details',lang)).includes(query)`.
improvements.acceptance: Web/Android user clears food search in one tap; a term present only in details returns the matching food.

improvements.title: Loading is a bare centered spinner while sibling ArticlesList (under the SAME segmented control) shows a 5-card Skeleton → jarring layout shift when switching Articles↔Suppléments
improvements.fix: Replace the ActivityIndicator block with the same Skeleton.Card loop ArticlesList uses (ArticlesList:217-225). Auto-inherits the reduced-motion fix once Skeleton is gated (rank 17).
improvements.acceptance: Tab switch shows consistent skeleton; no spinner→blank→list jump.

improvements.title: Skeleton pulse loop ignores reduced-motion — 5 simultaneously pulsing rects on Articles load for a vestibular-sensitive (nausea-prone) audience, though getReducedMotionSync exists and is used elsewhere
improvements.fix: In SkeletonBase: const shouldAnimate = animated && !getReducedMotionSync(); guard the loop, set static opacity 0.5 when off. Single-file fix covers every consumer.
improvements.acceptance: With OS reduce-motion on, skeletons are static; animated prop still works for snapshot tests.

improvements.title: EN favorites='Saved' collides with saved-state 'Saved' → chip reads '★ Saved', ambiguous (verified both keys = 'Saved'; FR Favoris/AR محفوظات distinguish correctly)
improvements.fix: Set EN common.favorites='Favorites' (or 'Saved items'). One-file edit; FR/AR/TN already correct.
improvements.acceptance: EN chip reads '★ Favorites', distinct from per-item 'Saved'.

improvements.title: The single most important fact (safe/monitor/avoid) is a tiny secondary-colored Tag above 4 equal-weight white cards, with no ✓/⚠/✗ icon — detail page regresses from its own list's bold safety rail and the D6-07 icon pattern
improvements.fix: Promote to a full-width safety banner under the title: row with getSafetyIcon (✓/⚠/✗, reuse WeekRec glyphs) at 22px + bold label in dark safety token, bg = surfaceGreenTint/Orange/Rose. Give the Precautions card a tinted fill (not just 1px border). Theme tokens only.
improvements.acceptance: Safety verdict is the visual anchor with icon+label+tinted banner; consistent with list & WeekRec; 4 langs incl. RTL.

improvements.title: Loading branch has no back button (user trapped on a stuck fetch — error/not-found branches DO have it); bookmark toggle has no in-flight guard (rapid double-tap can race two toggleBookmark on the shared module Set)
improvements.fix: (a) Render the headerBar/back arrow above the spinner in the loading branch of both detail screens. (b) Add const togglingRef=useRef(false) in handleToggleBookmark: if(togglingRef.current)return; set true; toggleBookmark(...).then(setSaved).finally(()=>togglingRef.current=false). Optionally disable while pending.
improvements.acceptance: Back arrow visible during loading; double-tapping bookmark lands on the intended state.

improvements.title: Web tablist is incomplete ARIA: no aria-controls/id, no roving tabindex/arrow-key nav, panel has no role=tabpanel/aria-labelledby, no focus-visible ring distinct from the 2px underline (correctly avoids the material-top-tabs RTL-blank-pager bug — verified)
improvements.fix: Add per-tab id + aria-controls + tabIndex (roving) + onKeyDown ArrowLeft/Right; webPanel role='tabpanel'+aria-labelledby+nativeID. Add a focus-visible outline token. Web-only block; native path unaffected.
improvements.acceptance: Keyboard arrows move between tabs; panel associated to active tab; visible focus ring; SR announces tablist.

improvements.screen: ArticleDetail (web reading width + dead seeMore + safe-anchor)
improvements.title: Long-form body runs edge-to-edge on wide web (no maxWidth); content-coming-soon fallback shows a centered t('common.seeMore') styled like a link with no onPress (dead affordance); anchor scroll uses a fixed 500ms timer ignoring reduced-motion
improvements.fix: (a) contentContainer maxWidth:720, alignSelf:'center', width:'100%'. (b) Remove the orphan seeMore caption or make it a real action. (c) Drive anchor scroll off anchorPositions[anchor] readiness (one rAF) instead of setTimeout 500; gate animated on !getReducedMotionSync().
improvements.acceptance: Web body capped ~720px centered; no dead seeMore label; anchor scroll lands reliably and respects reduce-motion.

improvements.screen: ArticlesList + SupplementsList (list rhythm + chips + card hierarchy)
improvements.title: List titles have no numberOfLines (long ar/tn titles reflow 3-4 lines, breaking the grid); ★Favoris chip uses a filled star in BOTH states (no inactive glyph cue); article card has redundant 'Voir détails' footer + Tag between title and summary (inverted hierarchy)
improvements.fix: Add numberOfLines={2} ellipsizeMode='tail' to both titles + minHeight on content for baseline. Swap chip glyph by state: `${favoritesActive?'★':'☆'} ${t('common.favorites')}` (or separate leading Text so RTL handles it). Reorder article card to title→summary→footer-meta-row; move category Tag (demoted to surface/textSecondary) into the footer replacing the redundant readMore.
improvements.acceptance: Cards share baseline height with 2-line clamp; Favoris star reflects state; article card reads title→summary with metadata grouped in footer; ar/tn no overflow.

improvements.screen: ArticleDetail / SupplementsList / ForbiddenFoods (perf + token hygiene + microinteractions)
improvements.title: Cluster of low-impact polish: heading rules/onLayout fire setAnchorPositions per render (matters only with anchor deep-link); content/linkedArticles not memoized; SupplementsList renderItem not useCallback (sibling Articles is); FF severity badge bg uses hex-alpha concat `color+'20'` (token-system violation); no debounce / no scroll-to-top-on-filter / no bookmark microfeedback
improvements.fix: useMemo rules ([]) + attach onLayout only when anchor set + ref-based anchor map (1 setState). Memoize content/linkedArticles/linkedSupplements; hoist sanitizeContent/slugify. Wrap SupplementsList renderItem in useCallback + SAFETY_CONFIG in useMemo. Replace FF:222 `+'20'` with theme badge*BgAlpha tokens. Optional: useDeferredValue debounce, scrollToOffset(0) on filter change (reduced-motion-gated), bookmark scale-pop+haptic gated on getReducedMotionSync.
improvements.acceptance: Article open is 1 render not N+1; no hex-alpha concat on FF; supplement cards bail on unchanged rows; npm run verify green.
